description: Implement the thin imperative shell over the pure core from FEAT-001: the env snapshot and injected Clock/NonceSource generator traits, the loopback-only bind helper, the shell thiserror error enums, rcgen self-signed TLS generation with printed SHA-256 fingerprint and rustls ServerConfig, the stdin/stdout prompt, the OAuth 1.0a three-leg startup flow (console authorize URL + stdin verifier) signed via sign_leg with a fresh nonce/timestamp per leg, the shared Arc<std::sync::RwLock<AuthPhase>> auth state, the axum router/handlers with verb-first admission, the reqwest Resource-leg upstream forward with a bounded (8 MiB) relay, /internal/status, and main.rs wiring the full startup sequence with anyhow. Depends on FEAT-001 (uses every core function). Leaves the crate building and all FEAT-001 tests still green; cross-FEAT integration tests live in FEAT-003.
steps: shell/env.rs: pub fn snapshot() -> EnvSnapshot reading ONLY ETRADE_CONSUMER_KEY and ETRADE_CONSUMER_SECRET via std::env (the single std::env seam).

shell/clock_nonce.rs: pub trait Clock { fn now_unix(&self) -> Timestamp } and pub trait NonceSource { fn next(&self) -> Nonce } (fresh per call). Real impls: SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).as_secs() with the documented .expect("system clock is before UNIX_EPOCH"); a CSPRNG (rand) producing a fresh Nonce per next(). Provide deterministic test fakes (fixed-time Clock, counter-backed NonceSource) behind #[cfg(test)] or a testutil module for FEAT-003.
shell/server.rs: pub fn bind_addr(ListenPort) -> SocketAddr => SocketAddr::new(IpAddr::V4(Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST), port.0) — the bind address is a code constant, never from data.

shell/error.rs: #[non_exhaustive] thiserror enums with #[from]: TlsError { CertGeneration(#[from] rcgen::Error), RustlsConfig(..) }; OauthFlowError { Http(#[from] reqwest::Error), UnexpectedStatus{endpoint,code}, Parse{endpoint, source: OauthParseError}, Prompt(#[from] std::io::Error), EmptyVerifier }; ProxyError { Upstream(#[from] reqwest::Error)=>502, UpstreamTooLarge{cap}=>502, NotReady=>503 }; ServerError { Bind(#[from] std::io::Error), Tls(#[from] TlsError) }. The OauthFlowError UnexpectedStatus/Parse #[error] messages name the endpoint constant and, on the request-token leg, flag oauth_callback=oob as an unverified assumption to check if that leg 401s.

shell/tls.rs: generate an ephemeral in-memory cert via rcgen 0.14 generate_simple_self_signed(["127.0.0.1".into()]) -> CertifiedKey { cert, signing_key }; compute the fingerprint by passing cert.der() (deref to &[u8]) to core::tls_fingerprint::fingerprint and print it to stdout; build the rustls ServerConfig from signing_key.serialize_der() wrapped as PrivateKeyDer::Pkcs8 and the cert chain from cert.der().clone(). No file is ever written.

shell/prompt.rs: print the authorize URL and the TLS fingerprint to stdout; read the verifier from stdin once, trim surrounding whitespace, and return OauthFlowError::EmptyVerifier if empty after trim (single prompt, no re-prompt). No browser launch.

shell/oauth_flow.rs: pub fn run(&Config, clock: &dyn Clock, nonces: &dyn NonceSource) -> Result<Authorized, OauthFlowError>. Leg 1 (request token): draw a FRESH (nonce, ts) immediately before signing, sign_leg(&SigningInput::RequestToken{consumer_key, callback:"oob"}, consumer_secret, &[], &nonce, &ts), POST to oauth_endpoint_url(REQUEST_TOKEN_PATH) with reqwest, parse the form body with the core parser (also parse-and-log oauth_callback_confirmed at info, non-fatal), non-2xx => UnexpectedStatus{endpoint}. Print the authorize URL from core::authorize_url. Read the verifier via shell::prompt. Leg 2 (access token): draw a FRESH (nonce, ts), sign_leg(&SigningInput::AccessToken{consumer_key, request_token, request_token_secret, verifier}, consumer_secret, &[], &nonce, &ts), POST to oauth_endpoint_url(ACCESS_TOKEN_PATH), parse, build and return Authorized. No value reused across legs.

shell/state.rs: enum AuthPhase { Pending, Ready(Arc<Authorized>) } behind Arc<std::sync::RwLock<AuthPhase>>; the /internal/status phase match reads under a guard that is DROPPED before any serialization/.await (Pending => core::status::status_body_unauthorized(), Ready(a) => status_body_authorized(a)); a poisoned lock at startup is a documented .expect site.

shell/handlers.rs + shell/upstream.rs: an axum fallback handler converts axum's Method and the request path+query into core HttpMethod/&str and calls core::admission::admit. On Forward(upstream_path): if phase is Pending return 503 (ProxyError::NotReady); else clone Arc<Authorized> out and drop the guard, split_query the mapped path into (path, query_params), base_url = upstream_base_url(&path), draw a FRESH (nonce, ts), sign the Resource leg via sign_leg(&SigningInput::Resource{consumer_key, access_token, access_token_secret}, consumer_secret, &query_params, &nonce, &ts), build the wire URL (base_url, or format!("{base_url}?{}", wire_query(&query_params)) when non-empty), GET via reqwest with the signed Authorization header. Relay: buffer the body with a hard cap UPSTREAM_BODY_CAP = 8 MiB (named const; size-limited chunked read; exceeding => ProxyError::UpstreamTooLarge => 502), copy the upstream status, copy only whitelisted headers via core::relay::relay_header_allowed (drop Content-Length and hop-by-hop), send the buffered body; an upstream send/read error => ProxyError::Upstream => 502. On Status: serialize the status body from the current phase. On Reject(MethodNotGet) => 405, Reject(OutOfPrefix) => 404; nothing forwarded upstream on a reject.

shell/server.rs (serve): pub fn/async serve(port: ListenPort, tls, state: Arc<RwLock<AuthPhase>>, clock, nonces) binding bind_addr(port) via axum-server's tls-rustls binder, placing clock/nonces/state in the axum app state so the handler can draw a fresh (nonce, ts) per request. Router: a fallback handler routed through admit (do not pre-route by method/path so the verb-first admission stays the single source of truth).

main.rs: #[tokio::main(flavor = "current_thread")] async fn main() -> anyhow::Result<()>: parse --port (clap derive, default ListenPort(8443)); shell::env::snapshot(); core::config::build_config(&snapshot, port) (on error print a message naming the missing variable and exit non-zero BEFORE binding any socket); shell::tls::generate(); shell::oauth_flow::run(&config, &clock, &nonces) -> Authorized, store Ready(Arc::new(authorized)) in the shared state; shell::server::serve(...). Add .context(..) at config/tls/oauth/bind boundaries; map any error to a non-zero exit. No unwrap/expect outside documented unreachable cases.
acceptance_criteria: `cargo build` succeeds with the shell wired into main (AC-1).
`cargo test` still passes all FEAT-001 core tests plus any shell unit tests added here (AC-3).
bind_addr yields 127.0.0.1 for every port and there is no code path to a non-loopback address (AC-9, unit/property test).
Missing/empty ETRADE_CONSUMER_KEY or ETRADE_CONSUMER_SECRET causes a typed error naming the variable and a non-zero exit with no socket bound (AC-11, exercised at the config layer).
The access token and token secret live ONLY inside the Authorized typestate value in memory; no code path serializes or writes token material to disk (AC-14).
Each OAuth leg and each proxied request draws a fresh (nonce, timestamp) from the injected generators immediately before signing (no reuse); real NonceSource returns distinct nonces across calls.
The upstream relay buffers the body with the 8 MiB cap, copies only whitelisted headers, drops Content-Length/hop-by-hop, and maps upstream/over-cap/not-ready to 502/502/503 respectively.
